svg.aria-label: Sequence diagram of one Attention Sink cycle from EventBridge Scheduler through the Run-Cycle Lambda, Bedrock, the policy engine and DynamoDB, then the cycle-completed event to the Analysis Lambda, and finally the public read API serving the exhibition frontend.

svg.text: The same thirteen steps ran twenty-four times. A cycle that fails part-way commits nothing and the next fire starts it again.
